name: Veros Veros Veros
storyline:
Rebecca Pham, 24 years old, freshly graduated in Alfajorería.

As time goes by, she fully realizes the harsh reality of the job market: "You won't always work in what you studied."

Because of that, she ends up working as a waitress at the Bum Shiko Bum restaurant, after the Boss took notice of her skills as a waitress, a salesperson, and, who knows how many other things you can cram into a description!

She sets out on her job, determined to improve her salary by any means possible.
summary: Maybe a waitress simulator. Maybe an arcade game where you play as a waitress, but in reality, it doesn’t really matter.
